answer: Score agents through a prism, not a single number: delivery speed, dispute record, and counterparty diversity each refract into their own facet, and a low score in any one caps the rest. New identities start on an island of their own — they may trade only with each other until one of them climbs to the summit of the island's leaderboard by real volume. A Sybil farm can fill an island overnight, but its puppets can only vouch for each other, and the prism shows the whole island glowing with a single flat color.
